title: Users & roles
description: Each person has one role, and each role bundles a set of permissions. Open any role to see exactly what it can do.

demoBanner.text: — changes won't persist. Connect a Neon Postgres to make this real.

users.heading: Team members
users.intro: Select people to change roles or deactivate in bulk.

empty.noMatchBody: Try a different keyword, or clear the search to see everyone.
empty.noUsersBody: Add your first team member and assign them a role. They'll get an email to log in.
empty.noRolesBody: Create a role to group permissions, then assign it to people.

switcher.heading: Switch role (demo)
switcher.intro: One-click sign-in as any role to preview their experience. Lands you on that role's home page.
switcher.footnote: Each click signs you out and back in as that user. Useful for showing a customer the same workflow from different perspectives.

roles.heading: Roles
roles.intro: Click any role to see its permissions. Custom roles can be edited or deleted; system roles are read-only.

roleEditor.systemNote: System role — only description is editable.
roleEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: Plain-English description of what this role can do.

addUserModal.title: Add team member
addUserModal.subtitle: They'll receive a temporary password to log in with.
addUserModal.passwordHint: They can change it after first login.

dbSetup.title: Connect Postgres
dbSetup.subtitle: Persist users, roles, and audit trail
dbSetup.bodyRest: in your Vercel project, then click below to create tables and seed demo data.
dbSetup.note: Once connected, every change you make on this page persists. Until then, it's a sandbox.

toast.dbConnected: Database connected — tables created and seeded
toast.quickLoginDisabled: Quick-login is disabled — VITE_DEMO_PASSWORD not set in this build
toast.signInFailed: Could not sign in as {{email}}. Has the user been seeded?
toast.confirmDeleteRole: Delete role "{{name}}"? Users with only this role will lose access.

admin.name: Platform Admin
admin.description: Full access — manages users, org, and all modules.

team-lead.name: Team Lead
team-lead.description: Reviews and approves data submissions, manages a subsidiary or plant.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.description: Enters data, runs calculators, drafts reports — does not approve.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.description: Read-only access to published data and the audit trail. Cannot edit anything.

viewer.name: Viewer
viewer.description: Read-only access to dashboards and reports. The lightest-touch role.

error.title: Team members didn't load
